name: TokenVector.UI
description: Thu vien UI da nen tang 100% TokenVector (.tkv) - zero dependency: rasterizer, font bitmap, effects, layout flex/grid, 28 widget + 16 native-look widget, media player, theme engine, model/view/SQLite, PDF printing, A11y bridge, font fallback, native dialogs, IME, UIA/AT-SPI provider, packaging/WASM tooling.

modules.name: TkvUI.Core
modules.summary: ColorRgba/ColorHsla, Point2D, Rect2D, Matrix3x2, PixelSurface (list[i64]), Theme, Insets/CornerRadius, DPI, SurfacePool-lite

modules.name: TkvUI.Graphics
modules.summary: draw_line (Bresenham), fill/stroke_round_rect, draw_arc (Sin/Cos), draw_polyline, clip_rect_intersect, draw_image

modules.name: TkvUI.Text
modules.summary: Font bitmap 5x7 (95 glyph + box fallback), glyph atlas pre-baked (text_atlas_draw_string), char_code, measure_string, draw_string (align/tracking/scale), wrap + ellipsis

modules.name: TkvUI.Viet
modules.summary: Vietnamese bitmap 5x7 (134 precomposed glyphs), UTF-8 sequence utils (vi_strlen/vi_seq_len_at/vi_truncate), vi_draw_bits

modules.name: TkvUI.I18nData
modules.summary: Baked subset font bytes (Hebrew/Arabic/CJK) + codepoint/slot tables cho text_atlas_bake_i18n (khong doc file luc chay)

modules.name: TkvUI.Effects
modules.summary: box_blur, kawase_blur 3-pass, backdrop_blur (glass), specular highlight, drop shadow

modules.name: TkvUI.Platform
modules.summary: detect_platform() thật (probe runtime), Win32 ULW thật, X11/Cocoa stub, Android/iOS host-driven contract

modules.name: TkvUI.Events
modules.summary: PointerEventArgs, HitTestResult, pointer_button_label, no_hit

modules.name: TkvUI.Input
modules.summary: hit_test_tree topmost-first, EventDispatcher (pointer capture), TouchEventArgs, GestureRecognizer (tap/pan/pinch)

modules.name: TkvUI.Layout
modules.summary: FlexStyle/GridStyle/Constraint, flex row/col wrap + cross-align + justify, stack, grid + span, DPI, validator

modules.name: TkvUI.Widgets
modules.summary: UIElement + 28 widget (15 base + DPad/ControlBtn/Joystick + 10 Ant-inspired), Spring/Tween, InvalidationManager, FrameScheduler, RenderLoop

modules.name: TkvUI.Media
modules.summary: Media-player UI: transport, seekbar, volume, repeat, shuffle, speed, playlist, equalizer+presets, spectrum, A-B loop, media_format_time

modules.name: TkvUI.Bidi
modules.summary: Bidi UAX#9 + HarfBuzz FFI stub + visual reorder + atlas draw (Hebrew/Arabic/CJK/emoji)

modules.name: TkvUI.Gpu
modules.summary: GPU abstraction + factory + backend pick + Vulkan/D3D11/Metal probes + shader pipeline stubs

modules.name: TkvUI.A11y
modules.summary: Accessibility tree model (role/label/value/states/bounds) + UIA/ObjC FFI stubs + JSON dump stub

modules.name: TkvUI.Font
modules.summary: Windows GDI font baker (CreateFontA+TextOutA vao DIB, GetPixel ve atlas alpha coverage), font_measure/draw_string. Optional, khong import boi umbrella (can GDI that).

modules.name: TkvUI.Theme
modules.summary: OS native-look theme engine: OsPalette 13 roles (Light/Dark/HighContrast), OsMetrics, OsTheme state, state-derivation + geometry helpers

modules.name: TkvUI.Widgets.Native
modules.summary: 16 native-look widgets (Button/LineEdit/ComboBox/Table/Tree/TabBar/MenuBar/ToolBar/Dialog/ScrollBar/Splitter/Progress/Slider/SpinBox/ListView/ToolTip)

modules.name: TkvUI.Data
modules.summary: Model/View/Delegate: flat cells, filter/sort proxy, MvTableState render, StringList, Text/Spin/Combo/Date delegates

modules.name: TkvUI.SQLite
modules.summary: SQL/ORM in-memory thuan .tkv: schema phang, CRUD, snapshot transaction, SqlTableModel (Data proxy), SqlQuery cursor, SqlRelation

modules.name: TkvUI.Printing
modules.summary: In/PDF thuan .tkv: PdfPaper/Printer/Margins, PdfFont Base14, PdfPainter (text/rect/path), PdfDocument+xref, table export, PrintDialog stub, PrintPreview

modules.name: TkvUI.A11yBridge
modules.summary: Screen-reader bridge: backend pick UIA/AT-SPI/NS/TalkBack, role/state maps, guarded UIA calls, event router, live regions, providers, reader detect, focus tracker, widget builders, JSON dump that

modules.name: TkvUI.FontFallback
modules.summary: Chuoi font du phong: Text 5x7 -> Viet 134 glyph -> i18n baked (Hebrew/Arabic/CJK) -> box fallback; monospace 6px/seq

modules.name: TkvUI.NativeDlg
modules.summary: File/Color/Font dialogs (API day du, stub cho Win32 that); filter/path/color/hex/font; render browser; SIM cho native marshal

modules.name: TkvUI.Ime
modules.summary: Bo go Tieng Viet Telex/VNI + composition state; tone/mu/breve/horn; composer thuan logic + OS stub; SIM cho IME that

modules.name: TkvUI.Uia
modules.summary: UIA provider kieu host-driven: fragment JSON + event outbox + live regions; SIM cho COM vtable that (upstream)

modules.name: TkvUI.Atspi
modules.summary: AT-SPI provider kieu host-driven: D-Bus envelope + event outbox + tree JSON; SIM cho D-Bus/.so that (upstream)

platforms.android: host-driven contract: set_jni_env + set_frame_buffer + set_dst_bits, cần shim JNI
platforms.ios: host-driven contract: set_frame_buffer, upload RGBA do host (Swift/ObjC) đảm nhiệm

constraints: docs/TkvUI.Roadmap.md §0 - ràng buộc compiler bắt buộc khi viết .tkv (không bitwise, không bool, record không chứa list, import resolve theo thư mục file nguồn...)
